result.title: Ranking-Preserving Coreset Selection for Efficient Evolutionary Hyperparameter Optimization
result.summary: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) is essential for high predictive performance, but its computational cost becomes prohibitive when candidate configurations require repeated training on large datasets. This paper proposes a ranking-preserving coreset (RPC) selection framework for accelerating evolutionary HPO. The method constructs a compact coreset that preserves the relative ranking of hyperparameter configurations observed on the full training data. Coreset selection is formulated as an evolutionary optimization problem that maximizes Spearman rank correlation between full-data and subset-based configuration rankings while penalizing subset size. The selected coreset is then used for HPO with three evolutionary algorithms: Genetic Algorithm (GA), Cross-generational elitist Selection, Heterogeneous Recombination and Cataclysmic Mutation (CHC), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). Experiments on seven tabular, two text, and two image benchmark datasets show that RPC substantially reduces HPO time while maintaining test accuracy comparable to full-dataset HPO across decision tree, text classification, and image classification tasks. Across datasets and optimizers, HPO-stage speedups range from approximately 1.14x to 8.80x, while the one-time coreset construction cost is accounted for separately through end-to-end runtime and break-even analysis. On 20 held-out configurations excluded from coreset construction, RPC achieves higher ranking correlation than same-size random sampling on 8 of 11 datasets (dataset-level Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p = 0.014). These results show that ranking preservation extends beyond the configurations used during selection. The one-time construction cost can be amortized when the coreset is reused across HPO runs.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 RPC 框架，用进化优化挑选一个小规模 coreset，使子集上评估超参数配置的相对排序与全量数据排序的 Spearman 相关性最大化，从而加速 GA、CHC、PSO 的演化式超参搜索。
AI.relevance_reason: 「以保持配置排序为目标选择数据子集」可能为视觉证据筛选提供一条线索：核查能否用「保留候选间相对优劣」作为筛选 latent 视觉 token 或证据的指标，而非仅保留绝对正确性；其进化搜索子集的做法也可供参考。
